ability_extra_money_desc:
Money rewards from defeating indicated enemy types will be increased.

(Units with this ability double the amount of money gained from enemies they defeat.)

Damage from most attacks is reduced significantly, but the unit will remain vulnerable to Critical strikes.

Units with this ability take only 1 damage per hit. (Toxic attacks, Critical Hits and The Cat God's Wrath of God miracle ignore this ability)

When struck by a Surge Attack from an enemy, strikes back with a Surge Attack of its own.

Surge type, level and spawn area are inherited from the attack that struck the unit with this ability.
damage and secondary effects are inherited from the unit though.
